meta_title: Fight a Speeding Ticket in Edmonton | Fabsy
meta_description: Review an Edmonton speeding ticket, its printed deadline, available disclosure, and whether Fabsy's agent service can assist.
h1: Fight a Speeding Ticket in Edmonton
hook: If you want to dispute a speeding ticket in Edmonton, follow its printed instructions and request the available disclosure; Fabsy offers a free eligibility review.
bullets: Disclosure review helps identify the available response options
what: Disputing a ticket starts with disclosure: review the evidence and consider next steps with Fabsy's free review.
how: Request the available disclosure, assemble relevant records, and review the available response options with Fabsy where agent services are permitted.
next: Upload your ticket for a free eligibility review.

faqs.a: Pricing is a flat $488 plus 30% of any fine reduction achieved; there is no additional charge if the fine is not reduced.
Attendance requirements depend on the charge, the court, and what happens in the matter. We will tell you if personal attendance is required.
faqs.q: Do I need to appear in court?

faqs.a: Timing depends on the court, disclosure, and the path the matter takes. We will keep you updated as it progresses.
